red_flags.label: Heavy vaginal bleeding
red_flags.message: Heavy bleeding in pregnancy needs urgent assessment. Contact your provider now or go to the emergency department.

red_flags.label: Severe headache
red_flags.message: A severe headache can be a warning sign. Contact your provider now.

red_flags.label: Vision changes (blurring, flashing lights)
red_flags.message: Vision changes can be a warning sign. Contact your provider now.

red_flags.label: Severe abdominal pain
red_flags.message: Severe abdominal pain needs urgent assessment. Contact your provider now or go to the emergency department.

red_flags.label: Fluid leaking or gush from vagina
red_flags.message: This could mean your waters broke. Contact your provider now.

red_flags.label: Fever 38.0 °C or higher
red_flags.message: Fever in pregnancy should be assessed. Contact your provider today.

red_flags.label: One-sided calf pain or swelling
red_flags.message: This can be a sign of a blood clot. Seek urgent medical care now.

red_flags.label: Fainting or severe dizziness
red_flags.message: Contact your provider now or go to the emergency department.

red_flags.label: Unable to keep fluids down for 24h
red_flags.message: You may need treatment for dehydration. Contact your provider today.
